Menu part constructors

Source: R/tier3-menu-parts.R
shad_menu_parts.Rd

Building blocks for shad_dropdown_menu(), shad_context_menu(), and shad_menubar() menus. Activating an item reports its value as the menu's input value.

Usage

shad_menu_item(
  value,
  label = NULL,
  icon = NULL,
  shortcut = NULL,
  disabled = FALSE,
  destructive = FALSE
)

shad_menu_checkbox_item(value, label, checked = FALSE, disabled = FALSE)

shad_menu_radio_group(value = NULL, ...)

shad_menu_radio_item(value, label = NULL, disabled = FALSE)

shad_menu_label(...)

shad_menu_separator()

shad_menu_sub(trigger_label, ..., icon = NULL)

Arguments

value

Item value reported on activation.

label

Item text.

icon

Optional leading icon.

shortcut

Optional keyboard-shortcut hint (right-aligned).

disabled

If TRUE, the item is not selectable.

destructive

If TRUE, styles the item as destructive.

checked

Initial checked state.

...

For shad_menu_radio_group(), shad_menu_radio_item() specs; for shad_menu_sub(), the submenu contents.

trigger_label

Submenu trigger text.

Value

An htmltools tag (or tagList) for use inside a menu.

See also
